def cloth_geometry(u,v,theta):

    t=.5+.5*(np.sin(a0+k*s)-np.sin(a0))/safe
    z=.5*(np.cos(a0)-np.cos(a0+k*s))/safe
    t=np.where(abs(k)>1e-6,t,.5+.5*s*np.cos(ang))
    z=np.where(abs(k)>1e-6,z,.5*s*np.sin(ang))
    t=np.where(lower,t,v); z=np.where(lower,z,0)
    z+=lower*.006*np.sin(np.pi*s)*np.sin(2*np.pi*u+theta)*math.sin(theta)
    x=126+2*t+u*(30+13*t)+1.8*z
    y=85+63*t-72*z
    sx,sy=source_xy(u,v)
    # The crumpled near edge relaxes as it is raised.
    x+=(sx-(126+2*v+u*(30+13*v)))*np.exp(-2.3*theta)
    y+=(sy-(85+63*v))*np.where(lower,np.exp(-2.4*theta),1)

    y-=lower*.48*(theta/np.pi)**5
